newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Cement Company posts 100 million riyal net profit in the first three months of 1997.
- Al-Razi company, an affiliate of SABIC, signs a letter of intent with a Japanese firm to construct its fourth chemical grade methanol plant in Jeddah.
- Riyad Bank's net profit for the first quarter of 1997 rises to 238 million riyals from 225 million riyals a year ago.
- Interior ministry executes a Saudi man for killing and raping another.
- Al-Sharq plastic plant in Riyadh undertakes a major expansion project at a cost of 150 million riyals.
